question: is there a club for ultimate frisbee or some kind of club sports team i can join?
answer:
Yes. Ramapo College Disc Club has an Ultimate team that competes in tournaments at Ramapo and along the East Coast. To join, email rchammerultimate@ramapo.edu. [2][4] All clubs listed are open to students. [6]

There is also a Sports Club, listed as a Student Organization. It offers opportunities to play pickup sports, support Ramapo teams and watch sports. Email sportsclub@ramapo.edu. [1][7]

Other competitive sports clubs listed are cheer, dance, ice hockey, rock climbing, tennis, wrestling, esports and mixed martial arts. Find details through [Intramural & Club Sports Info](https://ramapoathletics.com/sports/2018/9/26/intramurals-and-competitive-sports-clubs.aspx). [8] Intramurals include flag football, basketball, volleyball, softball, soccer, cardio kickboxing, Zumba, CrossFit and spinning; the page says these are for everyone, regardless of ability level. [9]

For help getting involved, check Archway or contact the Center for Student Involvement at csi@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7593; it is in SC 202. [3]

Sources: [1](https://archway.ramapo.edu/Sport/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/ramapo-college-disc-club/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/csi/commuter-affairs/involvement-frequently-asked-questions/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/ramapo-college-disc-club/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/sports-club/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/admitted-students/athletic/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/admitted-students/athletic/)

question: Hi, I'm a parent of a Ramapo student. What time does the concert in the Berrie Center start tonight and is there parking for visitors nearby?
answer:
The Berrie Center pages link to the performance schedule for event information, but don’t give a start time for tonight’s concert [5, 9, 10]. The calendar’s listed events are Take Back the Night, Thu, Oct 22, 2026 6 PM to 9 PM, Alumni Lounges, hosted by Office of Violence Prevention [1]; Laurel Game Night, Thu, Oct 22, 2026 7 PM to 9 PM, Laurel Hall 1st Floor Lounge, hosted by Laurel Hall [2]; and Spooky Movie Night, Thu, Oct 22, 2026 8 PM to 9:30 PM, Laurel Movie Theater, hosted by College Park Apartments [3]. None identifies a Berrie Center concert. For the concert time, contact the Berrie Center Box Office at (201) 684-7844 or tickets@ramapo.edu.

Public Safety says visitors must report to the Main Entrance Public Safety Information Booth for a temporary permit and may park in the D-Lots unless authorized elsewhere [6]. Another page says visitors may park only in the D Lot, specifically South Lots D-1 and D-2, and register at the Main Public Safety Booth [7]. These pages differ in how they specify visitor parking. A third page says to get a temporary pass at the Main Public Safety Booth and follow the Booth Guard’s parking instructions [8]. Public Safety (Non-Emergency): (201) 684-7432; publicsafety@ramapo.edu.

question: is there an a capella group or a choir club?? also when do they perform
answer:
Yes. The Ramapo Choral Club is listed as a Student Organization: https://archway.ramapo.edu/Choral/ [1]. Ramapo Choral is a vocal ensemble; previous vocal or choral experience is recommended, but a love of singing and willingness to commit to rehearsals and performances are the only requirements. [2] The Riffrunners are Ramapo’s student-run co-ed a cappella group. [3]

No upcoming performance dates or regular schedule are given. The Riffrunners have performed at campus and off-campus events, including New Student Assembly, Remembrance Day, and the Les Paul Festival. [3] A 2024 page mentions CantaNOVA performing a spring concert; that is past, not an upcoming date. [8]
